title: EMG: a healthy muscle
summary: Motor unit potentials of a healthy muscle during a gentle contraction.
description: The electrical activity of the tibialis anterior, the muscle at the front of the shin, recorded with a needle electrode while the person gently pulled the foot up against resistance, and then relaxed. Each spike is a motor unit action potential: the summed action potentials of the muscle fibres of one motor unit, which fire together. In a healthy muscle many motor units fire, and their potentials overlap. All three EMG recordings open on the same scale (−3.5 to +3.5 mV) and the same time scale, so that the sizes of their potentials can be compared (Fit, in the menu of the channel's name, enlarges it). Switch on Sound and press Play to hear it.
look_for: The shape and size of single motor unit potentials
How the activity changes as the contraction ends
